summary.en: Payment card numbers (credit or debit), Luhn check only.
summary.pt-BR: Números de cartão de crédito ou débito, só pelo algoritmo de Luhn.

isValid.summary: Validates a payment card number (crédito ou débito) using the Luhn algorithm.
description: Validates a payment card number (credit or debit): 12 to 19 digits and a Luhn check digit.
- No brand detection, issuer range lookup, expiry or CVV check.
- A number whose digits are all the same is rejected even though it passes Luhn.

- Accepts a string or a number, with whitespace, `.`, `-` and `/` anywhere between the digits; letters make it invalid. A number above the largest exactly representable integer should be passed as a string.
